name: Cyrillus
bio: Cyrillus is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors records the poet's date as unknown.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 369).

poems.title: Book IX, 369
poems.author: Cyrillus
poems.text: An epigram of two lines has every merit, and if you exceed three lines it is rhapsody, not epigram.
